content.short: 7K Aggregator is a high-efficiency DEX aggregator on Sui that optimizes trade routes across multiple liquidity sources.
content.description: 7K Aggregator is a decentralized exchange aggregator built on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide users with the best swap rates and minimal slippage. By dynamically routing trades across various liquidity sources, including AMM, CLMM, and Order Book DEXs, the platform ensures superior capital efficiency. It features advanced algorithms to reduce gas costs and an auto-listing mechanism for new liquidity pools. Additionally, 7K incorporates a "Drops" points system to incentivize active traders and facilitate future community-led growth within the Sui ecosystem.
content.meta: 7K Aggregator provides optimized trade routing and deep liquidity on the Sui network. Discover 7K and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
